name: every act has a word
headline: Every act gets a *word*
visualData: type a name | a tile exists
website | pages show as a site
* say it again | teach it to a friend
say: You can do almost everything by saying it. The command line reads plain words: type a name to make a tile, or a slash and a word to act. Say website, and a hive's pages show as a site. Because every act is a sentence, you can see what it will touch before it runs, repeat it, and teach it to someone else. The sentence is the program. Communities translate the words into their own languages.
